#include <iostream>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <utility>

using namespace std;

unordered_map<int, long long> tab1;
unordered_map<pair<int, int>, long long, hash_pair> tab2;

struct hash_pair {
    size_t operator()(const pair<int, int>& p) const {
        return hash<int>()(p.first) ^ (hash<int>()(p.second) << 1);
    }
};

long long compute_num1(int n) {
    if (n < 0) {
        return 0;
    } else if (n < 2) {
        return 1;
    } else if (tab1.find(n) == tab1.end()) {
        long long total = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            total += compute_num1(i) * compute_num1(n - 1 - i);
        }
        tab1[n] = total;
    }
    return tab1[n];
}

long long compute_num2(int n, int h) {
    if (n < 0 || h <= 0 || n >= (1 << (h - 1))) {
        return 0;
    } else if (n < 2) {
        return 1;
    } else if (n < h) {
        return compute_num1(n);
    } else {
        pair<int, int> key = make_pair(n, h);
        if (tab2.find(key) == tab2.end()) {
            long long total = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
                total += compute_num2(i, h - 1) * compute_num2(n - 1 - i, h - 1);
            }
            tab2[key] = total;
        }
        return tab2[key];
    }
}

int main() {
    int n, h;
    cin >> n >> h;
    cout << compute_num1(n) - compute_num2(n, h) << endl;
    return 0;
}
